scope: Static recommendation and publication-path audit; not a full dataset census or production query.

findings.finding: Recommendation candidates are loaded from Neon Dish/Restaurant SQL, not source-catalog menu arrays.
findings.implication: Published source menus do not imply recommendation readiness; eligible city totals remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: menu-coverage applies only non-null price and city; it does not reproduce star selection, coordinates, diet, budget or requested dish filters.
findings.implication: Keep endpoint label as priced records; do not use it as eligible launch supply.
findings.next_action: Add separately named eligibility breakdown with shared candidate gates and meaningful tests; retain existing count semantics.

findings.finding: Exact matching compares normalised brands and addresses without requiring either address to be nonempty. Two missing addresses normalise to the same empty string.
findings.implication: Could incorrectly match same-brand outlets without addresses; actual affected records not yet enumerated.
findings.next_action: Require nonempty address identities for address matching, retain distinct source-URL matching, and test empty/ambiguous/exact cases before deployment.

findings.finding: OSM records receive no menu; fallback legacy menus have brand_reference scope.
findings.implication: Do not promote directory-only or brand-reference records automatically.

findings.finding: Acquisition importer writes staging observations, not Restaurant/Dish recommendation tables.
findings.implication: Database-ready evidence import does not mean candidate publication.

findings.finding: Strict Jain/vegan/allergen requests return no recommendations when preparation evidence is unavailable.
findings.implication: Unknown dietary preparation must remain unknown.

sample.source: Existing repository evidence only; not newly scraped or a recommendation-ready dish count.
